caption: The drawing depicts a fabric bag with a rectangular, diamond-patterned collar at the top, predominantly rendered in shades of gray and white. The collar features a geometric black and white diamond design with the number "1793" centered along the top edge. The body of the bag appears slightly shiny or reflective, suggesting a silky material, and is shaded in gradients of gray with subtle highlights and folds. Thin brown ribbons with knotted ends emerge symmetrically from the sides near the base of the collar, extending downward past the bottom edge of the bag. Below the bag, on the left, there is an oval patch with a tan border, containing white text "D.C. 1792" on a black background. To the right beneath the bag, there is a fine-line sketch of the same sack, showing the general form and ties of the bag more simply. In the top right corner, a small, light sketch illustrates a grid-like weaving or stitching pattern. The paper background is a pale cream color, and the artist’s name, "LILLIAN CAUSEY," is lightly printed at the lower right.
title: Bag
